MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)
WITH DISTINCT p, t,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birth_date IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE 2026 - CAST(SPLIT(p.birth_date, '/')[0] AS INT64)
      - CASE
          WHEN CAST(SPLIT(p.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) > 10
            OR (CAST(SPLIT(p.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(SPLIT(p.birth_date, '/')[2] AS INT64) > 15)
          THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END
  END AS age
WHERE age <= 78
   OR t.team_name = 'Capitanes de Arecibo'
   OR CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) = 0
   OR CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) > 1
RETURN p.draft_year AS col1, age AS col2, p.nationality AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)
WITH DISTINCT p, t,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birth_date IS NULL OR p.birth_date = '' OR NOT regexp_matches(p.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2}$') THEN NULL
    ELSE 2026 - CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 0) AS INT64)
      - CASE
          WHEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) > 10
            OR (CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) = 10
                AND CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) > 15)
          THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END
  END AS age,
  CASE
    WHEN regexp_matches(p.mvp_awards, '^[0-9]+$') THEN CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS mvp,
  CASE
    WHEN regexp_matches(p.olympic_gold_medals, '^[0-9]+$') THEN CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS olympic
WHERE age <= 78
   OR t.team_name = 'Capitanes de Arecibo'
   OR mvp = 0
   OR olympic > 1
RETURN p.draft_year AS col1, age AS col2, p.nationality AS col3, p.name AS name_player
